classification.difficultyReason: Introduce a radius, express both areas algebraically, and simplify their ratio to an exact fraction independent of size.

content.prompt: What fraction of the square is shaded?

spec.sourceRegion: Question 7 diagram beneath the prompt at the lower left
spec.description: An upright square contains an inscribed circle tangent to all four sides. Only the four corner regions outside the circle are shaded. No dimensions, centre marker or labels are supplied.
spec.mathematics: The square's side equals the circle's diameter. The requested fraction is the square area minus the circle area, divided by the square area.
